subject: Geopolitics
title: BRICS: The Counter-West
description: Learn BRICS: The Counter-West in one minute.

hook.text: BRICS started as a Goldman Sachs acronym. Now it's a bloc of 11 nations representing 45% of the world's population.

buildup.text: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa formed the core. In 2024 they added Iran, UAE, Egypt, and Ethiopia.

discovery.text: BRICS nations share one thing: resentment of Western-led institutions. They want reform, not revolution.

twist.text: Internal rivalries undermine unity. India and China have border conflicts. Russia and India have different interests.

climax.text: BRICS is meaningful not for what it does, but for what it signals: the West no longer sets the only agenda.

punchline.text: A protest group is not yet a power bloc — but it's a start.

quiz.question: What is the common thread uniting BRICS members?
options: Shared desire to reform Western-led institutions
